_meta.openai/annotationJustification: Suggests field definitions from existing post values without writing anything.

description: Suggest fields for one collection from a sample of its items' meta.custom values (published data, else drafts) — writes nothing. Returns { sampled, suggestions: [{ field: { key, type, options? }, count, samples, defined }], skipped }. Review, then add the ones you want via put_collection_schema.

collection.description: Collection key exactly as list_collections returned it, e.g. "blog/" or "posts".

context.description: One sentence: why you are calling this tool and what you are trying to accomplish. Stored on the site's activity log and visible to everyone on the site — never put secrets or personal data here.

guestToken.description: Guest token from start_site. Send it on every call until claim_site. Omit when this chat is already signed in to Dotsy.

name: infer_collection_schema
